description: Looks up the public DNS record of the custom domain set with updateServer customDomain and updates its status; use it after the user changes DNS. A record that points at the server verifies the domain and starts routing players to it. A failing record is reported with its reason and never takes a verified domain off the server; one whose record stays wrong is revoked later by Pixly's hourly check. Returns check.verified, with a reason on failure, and the server.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
